tools.name: get_sold_comps
tools.description: The most recent real eBay US sales for a search query (brand, model or pattern, a few specific words), with the count, median and quartiles. Use when the user wants to see what actually sold and for how much.

tools.name: worth_it
tools.description: Net after eBay fees and a verdict (worth it / thin / pass) for an expected sale price and what the user would pay. Pure arithmetic; use price_item first when the sale price is unknown.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_on_ebay · Private data: buy_credits · Public sink: list_on_ebay · Destructive: buy_credits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_on_ebay · Private data: buy_credits · Public sink: list_on_ebay · Destructive: buy_credits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
